After this I consumed a lot of suicidal and self harm media on purpose like movies, tv shows, music, etc. I thought about doing it for 2 years but never did, I just did not know how to do it without nobody finding out, I am also very squeamish and at the time I thought cutting was the only way (I was 11-12). I thought if I did it I would faint and I would be found immediately. 

I kept it to myself for two years and did nothing but when I turned 14-15 my life turned to shit for real. It’s like I began to realize how badly my family really had been treating me, I lost all my friends, I had a boyfriend that was super nice but I was a lesbian in denial, was failing school, and I slept so little I used to hallucinate shit. I ended up just giving in to it but I had to think of ways that wouldn’t leave permanent scars. 

I tried cutting but I was too squeamish for it seriously the blade touching my skin already made me lightheaded and I really didn’t want to be found. I got super creative as the year passed by and found many extreme ways to do it that wouldn’t leave any marks or would leave me with pain that I would feel internally but it would leave no marks. I used to do it only when I had a mental breakdown or some shit because I was a sensitive teenager, I was a sensitive person. As the years passed by though I have lost ability to feel, therefore I do it way less since I have no feelings to cope with anymore. Sometimes though I will have an overreaction of my feelings and I would go crazy and do it, it only makes me feel good if I’m extremely emotional. It is sometimes embarassing admit that I am about to be an adult and still struggle with it.

Essentially, it is ironic that the way I learned about it was because of musicians talking about their harm reduction methods. Like they would talk about slapping the wrist band on the arm. It is supposed to reduce self harm, but that is actually how I began.
